title: You've taken the first step.
lead: This consultation is about understanding what your body is telling you, what may be connecting your concerns, and what needs to change for you to move forward.
note: Answer each question honestly. There are no right or wrong answers.
closing: Your answers give us the first picture.
During your consultation, we will connect the dots between your symptoms, lifestyle, nutrition and health concerns and identify the direction that makes sense for you.
Your transformation starts with understanding your body — not fighting it.

steps.label: What is the primary change you want to achieve?
options: Lose stubborn weight and reduce belly fat
Understand and manage hormonal / perimenopausal changes
Improve blood sugar / insulin resistance / diabetes
Improve digestion, bloating, acidity or gut health
Reduce inflammation, puffiness and feeling of heaviness

steps.label: Which of these are you experiencing currently?

Mind • Mood • Sleep: Mood swings, irritability or feeling emotionally overwhelmed
Poor sleep / frequent waking / waking up unrefreshed
Face • Skin • Hair: Puffy face or bags under the eyes
Noticeable changes in skin or hair
Energy • Appetite • Weight: Fatigue despite a full night's sleep
Energy crash or sleepiness after meals
Increased hunger, cravings or difficulty feeling satisfied
Unexplained weight gain / difficulty losing weight
Blood Sugar • Metabolic Health: Blood sugar fluctuations / insulin resistance / diabetes
Fluid Balance • Inflammation: Puffy hands, feet or face, especially after waking
Feeling persistently heavy, swollen or inflamed

steps.label: How long have you been dealing with these concerns?
What have you already tried?
steps.follow_label: What do you believe has been missing until now?
options: Multiple approaches, but the results did not last

steps.label: How ready are you to make your health a priority?
options: I am ready to take action and follow through consistently.
I am ready to change, but I need the right structure and accountability.
I am ready to stop experimenting and follow a personalised approach.

steps.label: If we determine that a personalised Eat Rrite program is the right fit for you, are you prepared to make the necessary time, effort and financial investment to follow through?
options: Yes. I am ready to invest in getting this right.
Yes. I understand that meaningful health transformation requires a financial, time and personal commitment.
Yes. If I see that the approach is right for me, I am prepared to commit to it.
